## Goal
ROADMAP BL-IN-01 asks for a full-registry scan that is cached and rate-limited. The cache (`CACHE_HOURS`, `src/freemyid/engine/exposure.py:79,650-655`) and a polite gap between requests (665-671) exist, but an HTTP 429 or 503 answer is treated like any other error (`_read` 428-437 raises `http_error`), and the scan keeps going at full pace to the next broker on the same host.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. A 429 or 503 answer (and a `Retry-After` header, if present) makes that broker `check_by_hand` with a new reason `rate_limited`, added to `HAND_REASONS` (`src/freemyid/exposure_models.py:25-39`) in plain words, e.g. "The site asked us to slow down. Try again tomorrow."
2. After a `rate_limited` answer, no further request goes to the same host during this scan: later brokers on that host become `check_by_hand` `rate_limited` without a fetch.
3. After three `rate_limited` or `too_slow` answers in one scan, the remaining network fetches stop and those brokers become `check_by_hand` with the same reason; the scan still saves and returns normally (never raises, 559-625).
4. `Retry-After` is never slept on (no long waits in an interactive scan); the injected `sleep` is called only for the existing polite gap.
5. Coverage maths stays consistent (`coverage_of`, `exposure_models.py:81-92`) and no new field is added to any model (the reason is a string key, 59).
6. Tests use the injectable `fetch`/`browser_fetch`/`sleep` of `scan_exposure` (559-565) with the `store` fixture; no sockets. Existing exposure tests still pass.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them.
